newsitem.title: USA: News Corp unit, Sinclair extend pact.
newsitem.headline: News Corp unit, Sinclair extend pact.

text.p: Sinclair Broadcast Group Inc said it and Fox Broadcasting Co, a unit of News Corp, had agreed to extend by five years the affiliation agreements for eight FOX-affiliated television stations that Sinclair either owns or programs.
The company said in a statement late on Thursday that the affiliation now extended through August 2001.

The new affiliation agreements, each of which include a five-year renewal option, will be entered into for the following stations: WPGH, Pittsburgh; WBFF, Baltimore; WTTE, Columbus, Ohio; KABB, San Antonio; WSMH, Flint, Mich.; WDKY, Lexington, Ky.; KDSM, Des Moines, Iowa; and WYZZ, Peoria/Bloomington, Ill.

Sinclair Broadcast owns or provides programming and/or sales services to 28 television stations and 25 radio stations in 26 separate markets. The television group reaches about 15 percent of U.S. television household, and the radio group is one of the 10 largest groups in the United States.
